These represent minor, bounded improvements to the user interface and developer documentation, without broader systemic changes or unverified benefits.

observations.behavior: Documentation update: the comment was changed to clarify that the menu bar now sits in the title row rather than below it.
observations.code_quote: // Under the Today layout the menus sit in the title row after the scene name. A scene without a title keeps the bar.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies the layout behavior of the SceneMenuBar component, which could help developers understand the intended behavior of the UI.

observations.behavior: Adds a new component QuillSceneStaticName, which renders a scene name with an optional description in a tooltip.

observations.posthog_connection: Provides a way to display a scene name and its description in a tooltip, rather than below the title. This could help users understand the scene's purpose without scrolling.

observations.behavior: Changes the import of useSceneMenuBarSlotFilled instead of useSceneMenuBarSlotMarginTop.
observations.posthog_connection: Uses a different hook to check if the menu bar slot is filled, rather than checking the margin top. This could help avoid unnecessary rendering of the menu bar.
